programme.title: Dead Presidents

programme.desc: (2018) Feel-good British family comedy. Sarah's (Beattie Edmondson) chaotic life gets even more complicated when she inherits a naughty pug from her nan.

programme.title: Film4 Interview Programmes:...
programme.desc: ...Talking Film: Stars and directors talk about the experience of making movies in this compendium of personal and practical reflections.

programme.title: I, Robot

programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Director: Paolo Taviani, Vittorio Taviani. Stars Margarita Lozano & Omero Antonutti. While watching shooting stars, Cecilia recounts when her Tuscan town defied their Nazi occupiers.

programme.title: Cause Célèbre
programme.desc: 1987. Drama. Directed by John Gorrie. Stars Helen Mirren, Harry Andrews & David Suchet. The story of Alma Rattenbury and her young lover, who were jointly accused of murdering her elderly husband.

programme.title: Richard's Things
programme.desc: 1980. Starring Liv Ullman and Amanda Redman. Richard dies of a heart attack whilst away on business, when collecting his things his wife learns that he had been travelling with another woman.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. The Lonely House. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Dorothy Bramhall and Bettina Dickson. A trap is laid for a couple running a murderous dating agency. (S1, E19)

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: 1963. Who Killed Cable Roberts? Directed by Jeffrey Hayden. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A legendary writer, documentary filmmaker, and hunter, is found murdered in his study.

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman
programme.desc: 1960. The Comet. Stars Michael Ansara, Jacques Aubuchon & Charity Grace. Whilst travelling back to Santa Fe, Sam investigates the reason behind a seemingly fake preacher in Libertyville.

programme.title: Child in the House
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Director: Cy Endfield. Stars Phyllis Calvert, Eric Portman & Stanley Baker. A girl is left with her relatives while her mother is in hospital. Her father, a crook, pays her a visit.

programme.title: Home and Away
programme.desc: 1956. Drama directed by Vernon Sewell and starring Jack Warner, Thora Hird, Harry Fowler and Kathleen Harrison. Based on 'The Huggetts' family rivalry when two sons win the football pools.

programme.title: Circumstantial Evidence (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Director: Daniel Birt. Stars: Rona Anderson, Patrick Holt & John Arnatt. Cleverly crafted crime drama - A woman seeks evidence that will give her grounds for divorce.

programme.title: Parade
programme.desc: 1974. Comedy. Directed by Jacques Tati. Stars Karl Kossmayer, Michele Brabo & Bertil Berglund. A tremendous spectacle combining music, circus acts and pantomime, hosted by comedian Jacques Tati.

programme.title: Suspected Person
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Clifford Evans, Patricia Roc, David Farrar, Robert Beatty, William Hartnell. Two bank robbers try to find their partner, who fled to London.

programme.title: White Corridors
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Directed by Pat Jackson. Stars Googie Withers, James Donald & Petula Clark. An insightful story about the day to day activities within Yeoman's Hospital during the early 1950s.

programme.title: Forbidden
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by George King. Stars Douglass Montgomery, Hazel Court & Patricia Burke. An ex-serviceman plans to escape his faithless wife.

programme.title: The Wicked Lady
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Directed by Leslie Arliss. Stars Margaret Lockwood, Griffith Jones & James Mason. 17th Century beauty Barbara Worth leads a double life to relieve her boredom.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Invisible Enemy. 1962. Joseph Brady, Brian Blessed & Stratford Johns. PCs Smith and Weir investigate a burglary assuming they're looking for a petty crook. What they uncover is much more serious.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is at the Cellar Club to open tonight's special show. Up first is next episode of The Omega Factor: St. Anthony's Fire.

programme.title: The Omega Factor
programme.desc: St Anthony's Fire. 1979. Stars James Hazeldine, Louise Jameson & John Carlisle. Anne accepts an invitation to an experimental unit where she receives a welcome that is too hot for her to handle.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is accompanied by a very special guest to introduce the fantastic 1972 film Burke and Hare.

programme.title: Burke & Hare
programme.desc: 1972. Horror. Director: Vernon Sewell. Stars Derren Nesbitt, Harry Andrews & Glynn Edwards. The 19th century body snatchers, supplying corpses for cash to the pioneering surgeon Dr Knox.
